description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Job Function: 

Communications & Corporate/External Affairs

Job Sub Function: 

Product Communications

Job Category:

Professional

All Job Posting Locations:

Chiyoda, Tokyo, Japan

Job Description:

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Haematology Communication & Public Affairs, IM Japan supports Innovative Medicine Communications and Public Affairs by helping to execute integrated communications strategies that advance business priorities, strengthen stakeholder trust, and enhance reputation across our haematology business in Japan.

This role partners closely with VP, Haematology Japan, key members of the Japan Haematology business unit, Medical Affairs, Global Therapeutic Area CPA colleagues, Public Affairs, and regional teams to contribute to clear narratives, aligned messaging and materials, and consistent execution in market. The Senior Manager will contribute to day-to-day execution, translating global strategies into compelling, locally relevant communications activations and ensuring a coordinated, high-impact approach across channels.

The role operates within a highly matrixed, global-to-local model, contributing to a two-way partnership that delivers consistent strategy through local adaptation and execution.

Key Responsibilities

Haematology Communications Strategy & Execution

Lead Japan communications and public affairs activations for our entire haematology portfolio
The role is a member of the Japan Haematology Leadership Team.
Contribute insights from Japan to the development of global communications and public affairs strategies for the Therapeutic Area, aligned with Japan’s business priorities, portfolio milestones, and lifecycle moments (e.g., data readouts, launches, growth initiatives).
Translate complex scientific data and strategies into clear, compelling messaging across earned, owned, and paid channels.
Adapt and deliver core messaging, content, and campaigns for local market impact.
Support proactive communications that differentiate our haemtology business in Japan, including disease awareness, innovation storytelling, and product communications, where applicable.
Accelerate Japan haematology product launches and support priority growth brands at key moments.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Strategic Counsel

Serve as a trusted partner to internal stakeholders across the haematology business unit, Medical Affairs, and broader cross-functional partners to support communications initiatives
Provide day-to-day communications counsel to connect Japan business objectives with communications outcomes and inform decision-making.
Align global communications strategies with public affairs, policy, and access considerations to support Japan market shaping and stakeholder engagement.
Collaborate with regional and global teams to co-create strategies and ensure strong pull-through of global priorities into local execution.
Operate effectively in a matrixed model.

Global-to-Local Integration & Execution

Enable a globally consistent, locally activated communications model by partnering with regional and global teams to adapt strategies, messaging, and materials.
Ensure alignment with governance, regulatory, and compliance requirements in Japan.
Contribute to coordinated execution of media, digital, stakeholder, and campaign activities in partnership with Global and Asia Pacific core capabilities teams.

Public Affairs Integration

Embed public affairs considerations into our haematology strategies to support policy, access, and market-shaping priorities.
Partner with Global and Asia Pacific Public Affairs colleagues to align messaging, stakeholder engagement, and external positioning.
Support activation of value narratives that reinforce access, reimbursement, and policy objectives.

Insights, Monitoring & Continuous Improvement

Support monitoring and analysis of media, stakeholder, and competitive landscape to identify risks and opportunities.
Contribute to measurement, reporting, and analytics to assess communications impact and inform strategy refinement.
Capture insights and best practices to improve global toolkits, messaging, and execution models over time.

Ways of Working & Operational Excellence

Operate as part of a connected team, contributing to shared priorities, resources, and Communities of Practice.
Leverage centralized tools, platforms, and capabilities (e.g., digital, media, measurement) to drive consistency and efficiency.
Prioritize high-impact, external communications aligned to business value, with disciplined focus on key opportunities.
Support simplification, scalability, and reduced duplication across communications efforts.

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree a plus
Minimum of 8+ years of experience in communications, public affairs, or related field (corporate, agency, NGO, or government) in Japan with a strong track record of results
Experience supporting global or regional communications strategies, including product or portfolio communications
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a matrixed, global environment and influence cross-functional stakeholders
Strong English and Japanese writing, editing, and storytelling skills, including translating complex scientific content into accessible messaging
Experience supporting media, digital, and integrated communications campaigns
Strong organizational, analytical, and project management skills with ability to manage multiple priorities

Core Competencies

Therapeutic Area strategy: Contributes market insight to global narrative, positioning, and messaging aligned to science and business priorities
Global-to-local integration: Enables consistent and effective local adaptation and execution
Strategic counsel & business acumen: Connects communications strategies to business outcomes and stakeholder impact
Cross-functional collaboration: Aligns diverse stakeholders and drives coordinated execution across teams
External communications excellence: Develops high-impact messaging and content across channels
Public affairs integration: Aligns communications with access, policy, and stakeholder engagement priorities
Analytics & insights: Uses data and insights to inform strategy and optimize performance
Operational discipline: Supports scalable, efficient execution aligned with governance and best practices
Collaboration & team mindset: Contributes to a high-performing, connected global team environment

Agility Jumps, Brand Activations, Brand Identity, Brand Recognition, Business Communications, Communications Measurement, Competitive Landscape Analysis, Corporate Communications Strategy, Corporate Management, Cultural Competence, Customer Experience Management, External Communication, Innovation, Organizing, Product Knowledge, Relationship Building, Technical Credibility

Job Description:

Position Summary:

The FP&A Finance Director serves as a key member of the Japan Innovative Medicine Leadership Team and acts as a trusted strategic advisor to commercial and functional leaders. The role leads strategic planning, forecasting, budgeting, business performance management, investment prioritization, governance, compliance, and finance talent development.

Key responsibilities

Financial Planning & Analysis:

Lead and deliver on the financial planning of the business plan, updates, latest thinking and scenario planning with financial analysis, insights and reporting on entire P&L and Balance Sheet. This includes the periodic financial performance reviews & BVA providing an overview of Japan IM financials to commercial leadership team as well as to APAC regional office, including key drivers of variance and insights into future impacts. 
Drive forecast accuracy and continuous improvement for planning, reporting and closing processes through simplification & automation.
Lead and achieve critical SigniFi milestones with successful adoption & stabilization of new system to drive greater business insights and a predictive analysis.

Business partnering and decision support:

Support the President and CFO in key strategic business decisions and strong business partnership with MC members, functional leads and APAC regional counterparts by looking for value-creating growth opportunities and providing constructive feedback to support profitable growth.
Actively contribute to commercial decision-making process especially target setting, resource allocation/prioritization and management of financial risks and drive cross functional collaboration with flawless execution.
Provide financial leadership to Japan Establish Brands unit, and HQ functions such as Medical Affairs, Integrated Market Access Team, Government Policy team to not only drive optimized efficiency, but also prioritize Japan IM policy shaping effort.

Compliance:

Ensure compliance with the J&J worldwide procedures, transparency and business conduct procedures and drive accountability throughout the organization.
Support local audits and ensure compliance with local regulations.

People management and Talent Development:

Attract, develop and retain top talent while creating the finance organization of the future and ensure collaboration as one finance team including GS, Tax and Treasury and be the single point of contact for Japan IM Finance.
Demonstrate ability to articulate and drive a team towards a strategic vision and be an inspirational leader to ensure Credo Values are demonstrated in the day-to-day interactions of the Japan IM Finance team.
Ability to provide mentorship to be an effective coach and have challenging employee conversations when necessary.
Coach key talents in Japan cross sector finance and committed to build a strong succession pipeline for the future.
Demonstrated ability to be decisive and action-oriented regarding decision affecting the team.

Qualifications

MBA or relevant Finance degree.
Minimum 10-15 years of experience within the Finance function or with relevant experience in finance, strategy roles or corporate finance.
Global or multi-national business experience strongly preferred.
Superior analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated intellectual and analytical rigor as well as experience resolving complex business problems with well-structured analytics.
Ability to adapt to dynamic, rapidly changing business environment.
Strong project management skills and demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives across a breadth of stakeholders.

【Innovative Medicine】日本 Business Insights & Analytics Analyst, BI&A Center of Excellence

＜Position Purpose＞

BI&A Center of Excellence に所属し、日本およびリージョンのコマーシャルリーダーと密接に連携しながら、Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine Japan の重点疾患領域における市場、顧客、業績データを明確な戦略的意思決定につなげるポジションです。BI&A Analyst は、統合インサイト、アドバンストアナリティクスのビジネス翻訳、パフォーマンスレビューを通じて、データドリブンなブランド戦略、市場競争力の強化、質の高い意思決定の加速に貢献します。ビジネスインテリジェンスの専門性をさらに高めるとともに、日本およびアジアパシフィック環境でリーダーシップ経験を広げたい方にとって、非常にインパクトの大きい機会です。

＜Key Responsible Area＞

Strategic Insights & Advanced Analytics Translation

コマーシャルステークホルダーの信頼される thought partner として、業績シグナルを実行可能なインサイト、提言、意思決定オプションへと翻訳する。
疾患領域の文脈、ビジネス優先事項、ステークホルダーのニーズを Data Science チームに接続し、アドバンストアナリティクスソリューションの開発を加速する。
担当疾患領域におけるプライマリーマーケットリサーチ計画と統合インサイト創出をリードし、意思決定のスピード、深度、品質を高めるとともに、組織全体のアナリティクスリテラシー向上に貢献する。
Monthly Business Reviews & Challenge

リーダーシップチームとの月次ビジネスレビューをエンドツーエンドで推進し、単なる報告にとどまらず、解釈、チャレンジ、アクションにつながる議論を実現する。
ブランド競争力、顧客エンゲージメント、HCP 行動に関する深掘り分析を行い、業績上の機会とリスクを特定する。
Asia Pacific BI&A ネットワーク内で、データ、インサイト、パフォーマンスストーリーの整合性を維持する。
Dashboards & Reports

担当疾患領域におけるアナリティクス可視化基盤を開発、導入し、ダッシュボード活用、レポート自動化、業績インサイトへのアクセス向上を実現する。
営業、プロモーション、リアルワールドデータなどのセカンダリーデータ分析を通じて、アドホックなビジネスニーズや戦略的問いに対応する。
Sales forecasting

クロスファンクショナルチームと連携し、Long Range Financial Plan、Business Plan、およびその他の予測見直しに向けた売上予測の作成と提出を期限内に推進する。
主要な予測前提について、収集、検証、文書化、透明性の高いコミュニケーションに関する高い基準を組織全体で維持する。

＜Key Competencies＞

Credo-based leadership: プロジェクト、パートナーシップ、コラボレーションの推進において、誠実さを示し、信頼を醸成し、利益相反を回避する。
Customer focus: 社内顧客の戦略的なビジネス背景と方向性を理解し、ニーズを先読みして期待を上回るインサイトを提供する。
Relationship building and management: 真のパートナーシップを築き、複雑または不慣れな状況でも自信を持ってコミュニケーションし、優れた傾聴力と問いかけの力を発揮する。
Strategic influence: 建設的にチャレンジし、選択肢を明確に整理し、ステークホルダーがデータ解釈から質の高い意思決定へ進めるよう支援する。
Learning agility: 変化するビジネス優先事項、データソース、分析手法、リージョン連携ニーズに迅速に適応する。

＜Skill/Knowledge/Experience＞

望ましい学歴: 大学卒業または同等の学位。Business、Marketing、Economics、Life Science、または関連領域が望ましい。
Business Intelligence 領域で 3 年以上の経験。製薬、ヘルスケア、または戦略コンサルティング領域での経験が望ましい。
定性・定量データを活用した日本の製薬市場パフォーマンス分析の経験。日本の医療環境および制度に関する深い理解。
優れたプロジェクトマネジメント、コミュニケーション、ステークホルダーマネジメント、プレゼンテーションスキル。
ビジネス英語力。TOEIC 800 点以上が望ましい。文書および口頭での英語コミュニケーション能力。
クロスファンクショナルプロジェクトのリード経験、および国際的またはリージョン環境での業務経験。

English Version

[Innovative Medicine] JAPAN Business Insights & Analytics Analyst, BI&A Center of Excellence

＜Position Purpose＞

Reporting to the Business Insights & Analytics (BI&A) Center of Excellence, this role partners closely with Japan and regional commercial leaders to turn market, customer, and performance signals into clear strategic choices for one of Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine Japan's key disease areas. The BI&A Analyst will shape data-driven brand strategy, strengthen market competitiveness, and accelerate high-quality decision-making through integrated insights, advanced analytics translation, and performance challenges. This is a high-impact opportunity for a business intelligence professional who wants to deepen disease-area expertise while building leadership experience in both Japan and Asia Pacific environments.

＜Key Responsible Area＞

Strategic Insights & Advanced Analytics Translation

Serve as a trusted thought partner to commercial stakeholders by translating business performance signals into actionable insights, recommendations, and decision options.
Connect commercial and Data Science teams by bringing disease-area context, business priorities, and stakeholder needs into the development of advanced analytics solutions.
Lead integrated primary market research planning and insight generation for the assigned disease area, improving the speed, depth, and quality of decision-making while strengthening analytics literacy across the organization.
Monthly Business Reviews & Challenge

Drive the end-to-end monthly business review process with leadership teams, ensuring the discussion moves beyond reporting toward interpretation, challenge, and action.
Conduct deep-dive analysis across brand competitiveness, customer engagement, and HCP behavior to identify performance opportunities and risks.
Maintain alignment of data, insights, and performance narratives within the Asia Pacific BI&A network.
Dashboards & Reports

Develop and implement analytics visualization platforms for the dedicated disease area, enabling dashboard adoption, report automation, and easier access to performance insights.
Deliver secondary data analyses, including sales, promotion, and real-world data, in response to ad-hoc business needs and strategic questions.
Sales forecasting

Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure timely sales forecast development and submission for the Long-Range Financial Plan, Business Plan, and other forecast revisions.
Maintain high standards for collection, validation, documentation, and transparent communication of key forecast assumptions across the organization.

＜Key Competencies＞

Credo-based leadership: Demonstrates integrity, inspires trust, and avoids conflicts of interest in developing and supporting projects, partnerships, and collaborations.
Customer focus: Understands the strategic business context and direction of internal customers, anticipates needs, and delivers insights that meet or exceed expectations.
Relationship building and management: Builds genuine partnerships, communicates with confidence, and uses strong listening and questioning skills in complex or unfamiliar situations.
Strategic influence: Challenges constructively, frames options clearly, and helps stakeholders move from data interpretation to high-quality business decisions.
Learning agility: Adapts quickly to evolving business priorities, data sources, analytical methods, and regional collaboration needs.

＜Skill/Knowledge/Experience＞

Preferred minimum education: University or bachelor's degree, or equivalent, preferably in Business, Marketing, Economics, Life Science, or a related field.
More than 3 years of experience in Business Intelligence, ideally in pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or strategic consulting.
Proven experience using qualitative and quantitative data to understand Japan pharmaceutical market performance; in-depth knowledge of the Japan healthcare environment and systems.
Strong project management, communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
Business English proficiency, with TOEIC 800 or above preferred; strong written and spoken English skills.
Experience leading cross-functional projects and working in international or regional environments.
